name: s1x_fwd_overflow_int12_seed_n511
description: S1 F9 probe through the SEED: every input and weight code +2047 (int12 x int12), N=511 (511*2047^2 fits with ~6.4e6 to spare, and 511*2^22 is provable on its own) plus a large positive bias seed (|seed| up to ~1e8 from a coarse bias scale): the exact accumulator of a positive-bias channel leaves int32. The guard's static bound includes max|seed|, so it must ABORT and its banner's max|seed| must lie in the range the seed policy allows; a guard that ignored the seed would wrap silently.
